summary: LakeShore Biopharma filed a 6-K announcing an EGM on June 19, 2026 to vote on a going-private merger per the Nov 4, 2025 Merger Agreement, as amended Apr 29, 2026. The company will be acquired by Oceanpine Skyline Inc. (Parent) and Merger Sub, with shareholders receiving an undisclosed price per share. The board, on unanimous recommendation of a special committee, authorized the deal and recommends voting FOR. Following merger, shares and warrants will be delisted from OTC Pink and deregistered under Section 12. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory clearance for deal completion.
